DESIGN_TRAP_1: CAUGHT BEFORE THE FREEZE. The literal prescription - permute e_2 within e_1-strata - is a tautology trap: if the strata coincide with the chi-square bins the K x K contingency table is EXACTLY INVARIANT, so detection returns the nominal rate at every rung BY CONSTRUCTION and the power certificate measures nothing. That is the same wrong-alternative-class failure one level deeper. The contract makes the Gaussian-copula reordering primary, keeps the block strata coarser than the grid, and adds DIAG-DEP-RHO to verify the plant actually moved the joint table. RE-DERIVING THE INVARIANCE ARGUMENT INDEPENDENTLY IS A MANDATORY SUB-CLAUSE OF THE REVIEWER'S DUTY 3 AT TASK-20260801-040, and a construction invariant at K = 16 or K = 64 is a REVISE. An asserted invariance argument that no independent session has re-derived is exactly the kind of claim this program has been failing on.
